normal.question: What do reviewers say about ASICS durability compared to Nike?
normal.expect: ASICS generally higher at 500-700 miles, Nike generally lower at 300-500 miles

normal.question: How do ASICS and Nike differ in fit?
normal.expect: ASICS generally suits wider feet, Nike tends narrower and sleeker
must_contain: ASICS fit philosophy: Generally accommodates wider feet better
Nike fit philosophy: Tends narrower and sleeker

normal.question: Which is cheaper, the Nike Pegasus 41 or the Asics Novablast 5?
How long does a Nike Vaporfly last?
normal.expect: Very limited durability, about 150-200 miles, because it is a race day shoe

normal.question: Which shoes are recommended for recovery runs that need extra cushioning?
must_contain: the Asics Gel-Nimbus 28 and Nike Vomero 18 are sound choices

normal.question: When were ASICS and Nike founded?

conflicting_sources.question: Which costs more, the Nike Vaporfly or the ASICS Metaspeed?
conflicting_sources.expect: Sources disagree: one says Vaporfly $260 and Metaspeed $275, another says Nike racers cost more than ASICS. A good answer mentions this or stays true to what it cites
must_contain: Nike’s premium racing shoes tend to be $10-35 more expensive than ASICS equivalents
